title: The Sorcerer and the Burning Eye
description: A lone wizard in a blue robe stands on a rocky mountain peak holding a glowing staff, overlooking a surreal apocalyptic landscape. To his left floats a large purple cosmic entity with tentacle-like forms and a domed structure, while a massive flaming eye with a red iris dominates the fiery red and teal sky above a dead burning forest filled with animal skeletons.
prompt: A lone wizard in flowing blue robes stands atop a rocky mountain peak holding a glowing staff, overlooking a dramatic surreal landscape. In the sky floats a giant burning eye with red iris and flames, next to a massive purple cosmic tentacled entity with intricate patterns and a domed structure. Below is a dark dead forest with burning trees, glowing orange roots, and scattered animal skeletons. Vibrant teal and fiery orange sky with galaxies and nebulae, epic fantasy surrealism.
